question: Introducing Kaumudi to a guest, a boy Mihir said, "She is the only daughter of my mother's brother-in-law". How is Mihir related to Kaumudi?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1547ed4a509f0a6bfe8df80f658e3f39359c9e9889086a7427a6110c94ecf76.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a88c18eba814ed27f4ccaaf4b250807f0ac97bc5815c5d54bf26e4c499954b7.png] 

Clearly, Mihir is the cousin of Kaumudi.

Hence, ‘**cousin**’ is the correct answer.
